chunks: We sent to Thamud their brother Saleh, saying: 'Worship God.' But behold, they were divided into two groups disputing with one another.

key_terms.صَالِحًا: Saleh, the prophet sent to Thamud

ai.seo_question: What happened when Prophet Saleh called the people of Thamud to worship God?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah An-Naml highlights the prophetic mission of Saleh to the Thamud, emphasizing the call to monotheism which resulted in the community fracturing into two opposing factions: those who accepted the message and those who rejected it. In Shia exegesis, this division is often viewed as a precursor to the broader cosmic struggle between truth and falsehood, illustrating how divine guidance inevitably reveals the spiritual states of the people. The narrative serves as a reminder that rejection of the prophet often stems from internal discord and arrogance rather than a lack of clear evidence.
